inventory.meaning: Exact locally present baseline support closure; excludes source not fetched. Source-byte verification does not mean every operation was reviewed.

public_owner_disposition: Preserve com.m3.collections public owners and callable interfaces; new contract sources are test-only.
target_writes: Actual qualified SDK Results only after all-input receiver admission.
behavior_scope: Repairs reproduce prior contract violations; unchanged observable traces are established only for retained differential and event-tape cases, not universal equivalence.
native_scope: Two extra Java reference-identity checks precede existing backend selection. Native sources, native ABI and JNI allocation path are unchanged.
excluded_claims: No complete review of all collection or JDK families.
No native throughput or allocation improvement claim.
No guarantee for concurrent owner or array mutation.
No flattening of opaque foreign filtered owners.
No whole-JDK promotion or new public naming mapping.
No universal comparator callback identity on the repaired null-sentinel branch.
No universal read-only endpoint closure; historical strict Map-derived endpoints remain unreconciled.
read_only_scope: Strict sequenced endpoint guards in this pass are limited to the Set family. The current outer JDK-derived Map wrappers are unchanged; the stronger historical strict empty Map-derived endpoint guarantee remains unreconciled and requires separate admission for concrete wrapper, marker and delegation behavior.
